label: MBT narration
note: Per-chapter MBT narration served from Cloudflare R2 at <base>/<prefix>/<bookId>-<chapter>.mp3 (e.g. https://audio.usmcmin.org/bible/8-1.mp3 = Ruth 1). Produced locally with Piper via bin/generate-mbt-audio.js, then uploaded to R2. The BTE reader probes each URL and only shows the chapter-page player once the file is live, so this 'books' map is intended coverage, not a guarantee that every file is uploaded yet. Pilot: Ruth (8) + Esther (17).
